correctness.rationale: The standard leaky-fort characterization is correctly used: an initial S resists any two vertex leaks iff it hits each nonempty W with at most two outside vertices having exactly one neighbor in W. The subset DP A(W)=b(W) OR any single-deletion A(W\{v}) exactly detects whether W contains a two-leak fort, by size induction, and thus counts every S using complementary W; minimal forts are b(W) and no proper subfort. The inspected source C++ loops over all masks of each of five genuine Platonic graph edge lists (N=4,8,6,20,12), not a sample. Independently implemented a separate C++ complete 2^N mask enumeration, including the 20-vertex dodecahedron, and exactly reproduced every two-leak forcing and minimal-fort coefficient. Two-leak minima are (3,6,5,9,8), optimal-set counts (4,16,6,2360,240); dodecahedral minimal fort total 1205=30+120+695+120+240 in five sizes, icosahedral 255 size-four forts. The larger graph input was checked for degree, edge count and explicit GP(10,2) graph isomorphism via inspected verification script.
